parameters.apprise_url_plus: onesignal://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.app_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own OneSignal destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-onesignal` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `onesignal://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` transformer channels skip Apprise and transform the envelope into a native OneSignal v1 notifications payload delivered straight to onesignal.com: `gateway` is free (direct to OneSignal v1 notifications), and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment OneSignal destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment OneSignal destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to OneSignal v1 notifications (no Apprise)

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's OneSignal apikey

app_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's OneSignal app

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's OneSignal targets
